A contribution is your site's slides and their descriptions, uploaded to the
BigPicture archive. The upload itself is done by a technical person, following
the [submission manual](index.qmd). This page covers what to arrange before and
around it.

## Who does what

- **You** arrange the agreement, the access, the planning, and the contact with
  BigPicture.
- **Your technical person** sets up a computer, prepares the slide descriptions,
  and runs the upload, following the manual.

## 1. Make sure your site is on board

::: {.callout-warning}
## To confirm with WP2

Your organisation needs an agreement with BigPicture before data can be shared.
What that agreement is, and who signs it, is not documented yet.
:::

## 2. Request access early

Your technical person needs access to the private BigPicture repositories and
container images. Without it, the first steps of every path fail. Request it
before they start, via the [servicedesk](mailto:{{< var email.helpdesk >}}).

## 3. Plan a test run first

BigPicture has two environments: **staging** for testing, and **production**
for the real archive. Have your technical person do a complete test submission
in staging with a handful of slides first.

Staging is not set up for sensitive personal data. Use only data you may put
in such an environment. See [Do a staging run first](bp-submission-pipeline/best-practices.qmd#do-a-staging-run-first).

## 4. Before the real submission

Uploading to production needs signed Terms of Use and separate production
credentials. See [Prepare for production](bp-submission-pipeline/prepare-for-production.qmd).

## 5. Hand over

Send your technical person the [overview](index.qmd). It helps them choose one
of three paths.
